messages.text: ‘Night and day different’ – why did Ferrari's pace evaporate again?

metadata.summary: Ferrari's wait for a first Grand Prix pole position since August 2025 continued in the United States on Saturday as Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton qualified outside the top three in a session the team had appeared favourites for.
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc discuss reasons why Ferrari went from US GP pole favourites to behind Kimi Antonelli, Red Bulls on grid | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc discuss reasons why Ferrari went from US GP pole favourites to behind Kimi Antonelli, Red Bulls on grid Ferrari had topped all three practice sessions but went on to qualify fourth and fifth; Both drivers hope race distance offers chance to battle at the front; watch the United States GP live on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event at 8pm on Sunday, build up from 6.30pm Sunday 25 October 2026 13:45, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton explain what went wrong for Ferrari during qualifying, despite them looking on pace Ferrari's wait for a first Grand Prix pole position since August 2025 continued in the United States on Saturday as Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton qualified outside the top three in a session the team had appeared favourites for. For the first time this season, Ferrari went into qualifying having topped all three practice sessions in Austin, on a weekend their car features the team's final significant upgrade of the season. Leclerc finished second fastest to McLaren's Lando Norris in Q1, but only after the McLaren driver completed a second run to do so, and then returned to the head of the field in Q2. messages.text: Antonelli takes surprise pole to boost chances of sealing title in USA

metadata.summary: Kimi Antonelli beat Max Verstappen to pole position for the United States Grand Prix to boost his chances of sealing a maiden world championship in Sunday's race.
metadata.content: United States GP Qualifying: Kimi Antonelli beats Max Verstappen to surprise pole to boost chances of sealing maiden F1 title on Sunday | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content United States GP Qualifying: Kimi Antonelli beats Max Verstappen to surprise pole to boost chances of sealing maiden F1 title on Sunday Kimi Antonelli stuns Max Verstappen to take pole in Austin; Antonelli could be crowned world champion on Sunday if he wins and other results go his way; watch the United States GP live on Sky Sports F1 & Sky Sports Main Event at 8pm on Sunday, with build-up from 6.30pm Sunday 25 October 2026 11:49, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 United States Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli beat Max Verstappen to pole position for the United States Grand Prix to boost his chances of sealing a maiden world championship in Sunday's race. The 20-year-old Mercedes driver is all but certain to become Formula 1's youngest ever champion but could clinch the title with five rounds to spare if he wins in Austin on Sunday and other placings go his way. It was perhaps the most unlikely of Antonelli's seven poles this season as he came from nowhere in Q3 to surge ahead of Verstappen, who had appeared for most of the weekend to be battling Ferrari for the front-row positions.
